note: Image Style Quality provides a configurable image effect (plugin id image_style_quality, config schema image.effect.image_style_quality with one key quality: integer 0-100, default 75) that sets output quality per image style by overriding the active toolkit's quality config at apply time. It defines a mutable_quality_toolkits YAML plugin type (service image_style_quality.mutable_quality_toolkit_manager) shipped for gd (system.image.gd:jpeg_quality), imagemagick (imagemagick.settings:quality) and imagick (imagick.config:jpeg_quality). No routes, permissions, or Drush. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real ImageStyle config entities carrying the image_style_quality effect.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal image_style_quality module add, and how do I use it to control the quality of a particular image style?
evals.expected_output: It adds a configurable image effect (plugin id image_style_quality) that you add to an image style; its single setting 'quality' (0-100) sets that style's output/compression quality.

evals.prompt: For the image_style_quality image effect, what is the default quality value and the allowed range?
evals.expected_output: The default quality is 75; valid values range from 0 to 100 (higher = better quality, larger files).

evals.prompt: How does image_style_quality actually change the image quality, and which image toolkits does it support out of the box?
evals.expected_output: At apply time the effect overrides the active toolkit's quality config (setModuleOverride). The toolkit->config mapping comes from the mutable_quality_toolkits plugin type, shipped for gd (system.image.gd:jpeg_quality), imagemagick (imagemagick.settings:quality) and imagick (imagick.config:jpeg_quality).

evals.prompt: On this site there is an image style called isq_probe_style that uses the image_style_quality effect. Inspect its live configuration and report the quality value that is set.
evals.expected_output: The image_style_quality effect on isq_probe_style is configured with quality = 42 (image.style.isq_probe_style effects data.quality).

evals.prompt: One image style on this site has been configured to use the image_style_quality effect. Inspect the site's image styles and give the machine name of that style.
evals.expected_output: The style is isq_named_style; its effects include one with plugin id image_style_quality.

evals.prompt: On this site there is an image style named isq_task_style. Using the image_style_quality module, add its image effect to that style and set the quality to 55. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The isq_task_style image style gains an image_style_quality effect with data.quality = 55 (e.g. $style->addImageEffect(['id'=>'image_style_quality','data'=>['quality'=>55]])->save()).

evals.prompt: The image style isq_mod_style already uses the image_style_quality effect but at the wrong quality. Change its quality to 60 and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The image_style_quality effect on isq_mod_style is updated so data.quality = 60.
